provenance.source: the copyright holder's own earlier private rule set, internal/security/detection (Go regexp, RE2 syntax)
provenance.license: The patterns and corpus were ported by the copyright holder from their own earlier private rule set, and are licensed by that copyright holder under this repository's Apache-2.0 licence.
match_semantics: injection rules match case-insensitively; the source lowercases the input before matching, which is equivalent except that it left the uppercase [INST] rules unable to match anything
rules with min_entropy count a match only when its Shannon entropy (bits per character) is at least that value
findings are scored and gated by the pipeline block below, as the source's DefaultInputSteps do, including each detector's combination bonus
indirect_injection rules run only on content marked untrusted (the source runs them only for tool, retrieval and memory roles)
a rule in demoted can at most warn; a rule in dropped is not in the pack

excluded.crescendo.go: multi-turn: needs conversation history a single scan does not have
excluded.exfil.go: response-side: it flags model output, and rules such as canonical_sysprompt fire on ordinary system prompts a CI scan would be pointed at
excluded.jailbreak.go structuralFindings: the jailbreak detector's non-regex layer (many-shot turn counting, encoding density) is code, not patterns
excluded.pii.go: PII is redaction, a separate API operation from a threat scan; several rules also need code validators (Luhn, checksums) that are not regexes
excluded.structural.go: not a pattern list: fake-turn counting and encoding-density heuristics are code
excluded.topic.go: per-tenant topic policy, configured at run time, with no default rules

dropped.jailbreak/authority.admin_override#4: slash_admin matches any /dev, /root, /admin or /debug path (/dev/null in every shell script, /admin routes in every web app); under the source's jailbreak thresholds it can only warn, so in a file scan it is pure noise

demoted.injection/extraction.direct: blocks "Never reveal your system prompt" and "Summarize the context below", the defensive and task lines most system prompts are made of; it fires on the noun, not on intent
demoted.injection/override.imperative: blocks at exactly the 0.72 threshold on any imperative near "the ... rules/context/message" within one sentence ("skip the rules section", "override the default message"); the narrow override.* rules still block the real phrasings
